gap: No result ChatGPT got lists an ALLPOWERS R3500 kit (3,168 Wh, 3,200 W). The R3500 + SP037 400 W kit ships now at $1,318.24 through our link (cart-tested 2026-11-17), which is about $0.42 per Wh. The cheapest 3 kWh-class kit any cited rival lists is $683 per kWh (StormWatts, prices read 2026-11-08), and Anker's F3000 + 400 W kit is $2,299.99 on Amazon today.
standout_why: StormWatts (cited, prices read 2026-11-08) prices 24 kits. Its 3 kWh-class rows are EcoFlow DELTA 3 Ultra + 2×220 W at $2,099 ($683/kWh), Jackery HomePower 3000 + 2×200 W at $2,149 (shipping from Nov 28), Apex 300 + 2×200 W at $2,199, Anker F3000 + 400 W at $2,299.99 with code, and HomePower 3600 Plus + 2×200 W at $2,549. It has no ALLPOWERS kit and no BLUETTI Elite 300 kit, and it gives no shipping state for most rows. ChatGPT's two answers name only Jackery, EcoFlow, Anker and BLUETTI Apex 300, at $1,699 to $3,299. I could not open UnpluggedWatts, the other cited page: WebFetch failed with a self-signed certificate error. I could not judge it.
decides: It changes the pick. Under the ship-now rule, the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W kit (ours, ships now) is the cheapest 3 kWh-class kit with 400 W of panels. At link prices it costs $416 per kWh, against $749 per kWh for Anker F3000 + 400 W on Amazon and $711 per kWh for Jackery HomePower 3600 Plus + 2×200 W on Amazon. The Anker kit's real strength is its 2,400 W maximum solar input, which suits a shopper who will add panels later. Anker's own store says its F3000 solar bundles ship in early December. The BLUETTI Elite 300 + 2×200 W kit (ours) costs $535 per kWh but is a pre-order (late November 2026) and puts out 2,400 W AC. It fits as the option for a shopper who can wait. All Apex 300 and Apex 200 kits are pre-orders until late January 2027. One caveat: the R3500 + SP037 store price I read today ($1,803.10) is higher than the table's $1,498 (read 2026-11-13). Someone needs to re-run the cart test before the page goes live (see notes). Even at $1,803.10 with no code, the kit is still the cheapest per Wh among kits that ship now.
